_comment: Hull classes, world bible section 6. Names and prose live here; the numbers live in sim/constants.ts, keyed by role, so both fleets are balanced identically and only their names and character differ. Section 6 lists fifteen classes a side; these are the three that need no research.

classes.name: Sovereign
classes.blurb: A first-rate of the line, built straight and warded with cultivated coral. The backbone of the Crown fleet.

classes.name: Kestrel
classes.blurb: A sloop-of-war. Fast, lightly gunned, and the quickest hull the Crown can put to sea.

classes.name: Fluyt
classes.blurb: An unarmed merchantman pressed into service. Carries companies and nothing else.

classes.name: Tempest
classes.blurb: A frigate patched together out of three others. Not pretty. Fights as well as anything the Crown has.

classes.name: Swift
classes.blurb: A schooner, stolen and re-rigged. Outruns everything and picks off small craft.

classes.name: Brig
classes.blurb: A blunt-nosed hauler. No guns worth the name, but it lands companies where they are wanted.
